source_observations: Canopy Routes is roofed supply/trail-office infrastructure on an existing public bridge; shared traversable bridge deck persists in background.
Upper-left optional river inlet is conditional state art; supported piling/gangway access meets shared dry bridge deck. SHIP inherits native shipyard upgrade and contains complete quay plus vessel.
Main council, scholar campus and residential wings use independent actual door/frontage annotations; meaningful lower states are separately painted.
Approved maximum RGB pixels remain unchanged. Matte guide supplies only bounded alpha, not replacement architecture RGB.
Bounded upper/lower terrace projections have exact complete/foreground-absent/intersection evidence; no door/access occlusion is exempted.

art_production.creative_bitmap_skill: imagegen/SKILL.md read; use default built-in mode, no API/CLI fallback.
art_production.method: Genuine built-in imagegen painted 2D source cohorts, followed by deterministic crop, uniform per-family scale, fixed roots, PNG alpha preservation and native JSON/masks/icons.
art_production.private_reference_boundary: Reference bytes and actual local provider receipts stay in private build reports. Public sources record official URL/hash and project-relative editable dependencies only.
regional_references: Official Mastery Over the Material Realm full illustration
art_production.release_boundary: Source composition and technical conversion do not grant native click/rendering acceptance, external final art approval or redistribution clearance.
art_production.reproducibility: Preserve every selected master, exact prompt, provider receipt, calibration, recipe, source pin and native frame. Index HALL by actual native BuildingID, preserving gaps.
art_production.transparency: Generate genuine transparent RGBA building layers; preserve alpha. Walls, roofs and windows must be materially opaque, with controlled attached contact shadows. No floor reflection passes through the building.

authority_quotes: Design the town as one immersive place before splitting functional layers.
Before repainting a background, make a complete placement plan using the selected buildings' actual full silhouettes, roofs, towers, stairs, foundations and contact shadows.
Seven troop tiers need seven dwelling sites in total: base and upgrade develop the same site.
Code may perform technical conversion, cropping, palette/alpha processing, fixed roots, masks, frame assembly and validation; artistic content must come from coherent painted 2D sources.
The user requires visible regional crests on every Runeterra town and its units.

community.architecture: Pale stepped masonry with sweeping buttress fins, recessed shaded courts, low arcades, planted roof rims and restrained gold/ochre geometric linework. Darkwood screens and practical jade-cloth shade structures distinguish smaller working services from monumental rear institutions.
community.canonical_basis: The official region describes inhabited arcologies, deliberate elemental study, material craft and Path Wardens tending inter-arcology routes. Ixtal says it needs no armies; its actual institutions and independent jungle ecology remain distinct.
community.excluded: No European Castle recolor, generic Aztec pyramid village, hut catalogue, Ionian cherry blossoms, Piltover machinery, Zaun chemistry or copied full LoR image.
community.project_fiction: One compressed jungle-edge expedition district brings civic craft and study to negotiated animal-refuge access. It is neither an actual map of Ixaocan nor evidence of a universal royal army, tame-fauna breeding industry or unanimous Yun Tal allegiance.

composition.background_rule: Background contains shared landscape, retaining supports, routes, stairs, controlled vegetation and incidental civic banners, never completed constructible architecture. No opaque plot tiles, inaccessible floating doors or foreground vegetation hiding the city.
composition.camera: Lower theatrical three-quarter matte-painting view with readable front doors, modest roof planes and elevated horizon. Forced depth, not a strict isometric grid or real camera distortion.
composition.ground_and_water: All ordinary foundations/door approaches are dry connected terraces. A small upper-left river inlet supports only the intentional optional quay/ship. Its complete pier, pylons and gangway must visibly meet land. No ordinary building sits over accidental water.
composition.physical_and_apparent_scale: Large rear council, Axiom campus and gate retain monumental mass at compressed distance. Foreground services have larger apparent doorway/material scale. Small route posts and animal refuge architecture differ in footprint and height. There is no universal near/far numeric ratio.
composition.plot_contract: One site per tier; base and upgrade are meaningful replacement-state developments on the same root. Hall4, Guild5 and Fort3 each share their own campus. Seven dwelling pairs, four services and two specials complete sixteen ordinary sites; coast and Grail are explicit extras.
composition.prepaint_contract: Freeze maximum full silhouette/contact-shadow envelopes before painting. Measure selected genuine masters and correct clipping/root calibration before selecting a backdrop. Never invent alpha bounding boxes as proof of visual coherence.

heraldry.latest_override: The older scoped brief's beast exemption is superseded by the current shared policy and latest user correction. All fourteen units require a lore-compatible visible regional association mark; that does not claim royal ownership or canonical domestication.
heraldry.native_legibility: Pending actual downsampled pixel inspection, not inferred from a prompt, reference hash, metadata or UI faction icon.
heraldry.shape: Tall tapered stem with small flared fan cap and branch cutouts, broad upswept lower crescent arms, central interlaced elongated diamond lattice/downward point.
heraldry.town_surfaces: Generous jade civic cloth with muted-gold glyphs and warm-stone engraved plaques. A fixed incidental route banner preserves visibility in empty/early states; hall, gate and services add independent physical crests in built states.

institutions.art_boundary: A local council campus, not a literal duplicate of the entire ruling caste or Qiyana's completed accession.
Disciplined material-study architecture, no invented fifth magic school or automatic school immunity.
A physical mineral and craft store. Gems are native gameplay resources; no conscious brackern or omnipotent elemental factory.
A real visible trail and supply station. Native effect is coordinator-authored; no invisible extra dwelling.
A small controlled axiom court. Native recharge is coordinator-authored; no free summoning or unlimited mana implied by art.

scope: Painted town-source production and exact geometry; native integration is coordinator-owned.
